detailed_explanation: The numerical difference between Phase B2 (0.2278-0.3150) and Phase B3 (>0.85) is entirely explained by experimental parameters and duration. In Phase B2, investigations were bounded at 6 cycles and evaluated under realistic low-density telemetry where each cycle yielded 1 finding, causing steady un-drifted growth terminating at the 6-cycle safety bound. In Phase B3 long-run testing, investigations were given up to 15 cycles under dense multi-source productive telemetry with high corroboration bonuses, allowing cumulative logit growth to cross the 0.85 completion threshold at cycle 5. The underlying mathematical confidence update engine is identical.
